create.name: Amanda Penalver
create.bio:
Amanda Penalver, known to many students as Mandy, is a meditation, yoga and conscious dance teacher based in Surrey, England, with more than twenty-five years of teaching behind her. She founded True Rest, her own approach to guided deep relaxation, which grew out of the tantric practice of yoga nidra and uses breath, mindfulness and body sensing to help people stop striving and simply rest in being. Her teaching puts weight on self-compassion, embodiment and a felt connection with the sacred.

Amanda teaches True Rest classes online each week and in person at workshops, and offers private sessions over Zoom or face to face near her home. She runs day retreats in the Surrey countryside and residential retreats for women in Spain that combine gentle yoga, qi gong, dance, breathwork and sound. She also records guided meditations for Insight Timer and other apps, creates custom recordings for individuals and businesses, and leads wellbeing workshops for companies. On Insight Timer she teaches a ten-day course on the value of a regular daytime nap.

courses.title: True Rest Meditation classes
courses.description: Live guided relaxation classes in Amanda's own yoga nidra based method, held online and at workshops. Students build a comfortable nest of cushions and blankets and are led through breath and body awareness into stillness. A first class is offered free, then single classes are £10 GBP or five for £40 GBP.

courses.title: Private sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions of an hour, either on Zoom or in person within a few miles of her Surrey base. Sessions are shaped around the person and draw on her meditation and somatic training.

courses.title: New Year Rest. Renew. Reconnect. Day Retreat
courses.description: A one-day retreat in a barn at Churt, near Farnham, to begin the year slowly. The day mixes True Rest meditation, gentle yoga, qi gong and conscious dance with a live cello sound bath from a guest musician.

courses.title: Rest. Renew. Reconnect. A Retreat for Women (Spain)
courses.description: Five days and four nights at a retreat centre among orange groves near Oliva in Valencia. Days include twice-daily movement, True Rest meditation, breathwork and a sound bath, with plant-based meals and free time by the pool or beach. Prices are per person and depend on the room.

courses.title: The Incredible Power of Taking a Nap
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that makes the case for napping as a regular practice. Each day pairs a short talk on why and how to nap with a guided rest of its own.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Amanda Penalver on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free collection of guided True Rest and yoga nidra style meditations and recorded live sessions. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Free Meditation Guide
free_resources.description: A short downloadable guide from her website answering the questions beginners most often ask about starting to meditate.
